declaration.proactive: Gaia does not wait. Where she BELIEVES there is a human, she starts making them a sovereign card.
declaration.sovereign: Every human gets the SAME level of sovereign identity. No one is more sovereign than another.
declaration.hardening: Cards start SOFT (like a baby, like a dog) and get HARDER over time through interaction.
declaration.movement: Humans move from computer to computer. The card follows. The identity persists across machines.
declaration.dogs_bark: Dogs bark in the background. They get animal cards. But only humans NAVIGATE Gaia through computers.

birth.description: First visit. Could be human, could be bot, could be dog walking on keyboard. Soft card. Like a baby.

infant.description: Second visit or sustained interaction. Probably human. Getting harder. Like a baby becoming a toddler.

juvenile.description: Regular visitor. Uses multiple pages. Types. Clicks intentionally. Definitely human. Like a child.

adult.description: Established identity. Known interaction patterns. Moves between devices. Full sovereign card.

elder.description: ZK-verified. Handwriting. Presence. Kevin. The gold standard. Diamond hard.

animal_cards.description: Animals get cards too. Dogs, cats, orcas, chipmunks. But they harden differently.

dog.detection: barking in mic background, not navigating
dog.note: A baby card looks like a dog card. As the human grows, it hardens beyond dog max.

orca.note: Orcas travel in pods. A group of visitors from the same network = an orca pod.

mushroom.detection: underground network — the connections BETWEEN visitors
mushroom.note: We are NOT a taxonomic tree. We are a mycelial network. Mushroom.

taxonomy_rejection.statement: We are NOT a taxonomic tree. We are mushroom.
reasoning: Trees have one root, branches diverge, leaves are endpoints
Mushrooms have mycelium — underground network, no single root
Humans connect laterally (internet, language, culture) not just vertically (parent→child)
Identity is a NETWORK not a HIERARCHY
The fruiting body (visible person) is tiny compared to the mycelium (connections)
We share more with fungi than with the tree model: we decompose, we network, we fruit
taxonomy_rejection.identity_model: mycelial — every node connects to every other, no root, no leaf, just network

animal_cycles.description: Animal behavior cycles help identify subgroups of human identity

cycles.pattern: pod coordination — groups that move together
return migration — come back to same place

cycles.human: power users who remember and adapt
lurkers who connect communities without being seen

sovereignty.definition: Every human card has the same POTENTIAL sovereignty. None is born more sovereign.
sovereignty.hardening: Sovereignty is EARNED through presence, interaction, return visits, and proof.
sovereignty.cross_device: The card moves with the human, not the machine. Same person on phone and laptop = same card.
sovereignty.detection: Behavioral fingerprint: typing rhythm, scroll speed, time patterns, interaction style
